title: OxfordAQA International Advanced Subsidiary Physics
summary: OxfordAQA International AS Physics is a modular international qualification for study outside the United Kingdom.
The AS stage uses Unit 1 (Mechanics, materials and atoms) and Unit 2 (Electricity, waves and particles).
Each AS unit is a two-hour, 80-mark written paper worth 50% of AS and 20% of the full International A-level.
The Version 5.1 specification assesses practical knowledge through written papers rather than a separate practical examination.
AS content covers sections 3.1 to 3.5; sections 3.6 to 3.13 are International A-level only.

qualification_family: OxfordAQA International AS and A-level Physics (9630)
assessment_objectives: AO1: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of scientific ideas, processes, techniques and procedures.
AO2: Apply knowledge and understanding of scientific ideas, processes, techniques and procedures in familiar and unfamiliar contexts.
AO3: Analyse, interpret and evaluate scientific information, ideas and evidence, including in different forms.
AO4: Select, describe and evaluate scientific procedures.
